en: Black‑and‑white view of a broad cobblestoned street lined with rows of pollarded trees and late‑19th‑century townhouses. On the left stands a large church with a tall, steep spire and ornate clock‑face decoration. Several pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk across the square; a horse‑drawn wagon is visible further down the street. The architecture is Central European, with brick facades and tiled roofs.
